# Air Quality Monitor

> A live dashboard of the air in an office in Kololo, Kampala, Uganda, measured by a home-built sensor. A Plantower PMS5003 reports PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 every minute, with a DHT22 for temperature and humidity, and a three.js dashboard draws the readings in five 3D views. Built by Jonathan Orlowski.

PM2.5 is compared with WHO's 2021 24-hour guideline (15 µg/m³) and its interim targets (25, 37.5, 50 and 75 µg/m³). The dashboard is in English and Argentine Spanish. The readings are public and can be read straight from the API below, which is simpler than reading the 3D page.

## Data API

Base URL: https://pollution.jonathan-orlowski.dev. JSON, no key needed for reading. Times are UTC.

- [Latest readings](https://pollution.jonathan-orlowski.dev/readings?limit=60): minute averages, newest first. `limit` 1–2000 (default 100); `since` returns only readings after an ISO timestamp. Fields: `pm1_0`, `pm2_5`, `pm10` (µg/m³); `n0_3` to `n10` (particles per 0.1 L at or above each size in µm); `temperature_c`; `humidity_pct`; `createdAt`.
- [Time buckets](https://pollution.jonathan-orlowski.dev/readings/bins?days=1&minutes=60): means per bucket. `days` 1–31 (default 14); `minutes` 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60 (default 5). Fields: `t` (bucket start), `pm1`, `pm25`, `pm10`, `temp`, `hum`, `n` (minutes recorded).
- [Daily means](https://pollution.jonathan-orlowski.dev/readings/daily?days=30&tz=Africa/Kampala): means per calendar day. `days` 1–400 (default 182); `tz` an IANA time zone (default UTC). Fields: `day` (YYYY-MM-DD), `pm1`, `pm25`, `pm10`, `temp`, `hum`, `n`.

Temperature and humidity are null where the sensor gave no reading. Temperatures before 16 October 2026 came from a faulty TMP36 and have been removed, and humidity starts that day.

## Project

- [Live dashboard](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/pollution/): the five views are a 24-hour clock of minute readings, the particles in one breath, 14 days as a landscape, the last 24 hours split by particle size, and a 26-week calendar of daily means.
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/jonorl/pollution): Rust firmware for the ESP32-S3, a Fastify and Prisma API on PostgreSQL, the React dashboard, and a React Native app, with wiring and set-up notes.
- [Android app](https://github.com/jonorl/pollution/releases/download/Android/pollution.apk): the same dashboard as an APK, built with Expo.

## Optional

- [Jonathan Orlowski's site](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/): other projects, and the site-wide llms.txt.
